title: MCP gallery
description: Connect external services or check the actual availability of built-in sandbox tools.
loadFailed: Could not load the catalog. Refresh to check again.
actionFailed: Could not confirm the action's outcome. Refresh to check the current connection status.
managerHelp: You can manage this organization's connections. Each user must activate the current version separately.
memberHelp: You can activate organization connections for your account. Only managers can change organization credentials.
catalogError: Could not verify the tool list.
deleteConfirm: Delete the {name} connection? If this is an organization connection, all members will lose access.
sharedWarning: Organization credentials are shared by members. Changing them invalidates OAuth and approvals for previous versions.
globalWarning: This will be published to all users. Users must activate it separately and approve OAuth access.
personalHelp: This connection is available only to the current user in the current project.
label: Connection name (optional)
secretHelp: Header values are not shown after saving. Do not enter existing headers you want to keep unchanged. Secrets are cleared when the request is sent.
managedAvailable: The sandbox execution configuration is available. Explicitly select the local tools you want to use.
profileMissing: This tool is not in the active sandbox image. An operator must enable the profile.
protocolMissing: Execution protocol v2 or the sandbox pool is not ready.
stdioOnly: Local stdio only. It cannot be connected here because no secure hosted HTTPS address is available.
unavailable: No usable secure remote server has been confirmed.
oauthHelp: After creating the connection, approve OAuth access with the service.
credentialsHelp: You or an organization manager must enter authentication headers.
configureHelp: You must specify URL variables and an authentication method.
publicHelp: This remote server requires no authentication. Personal connections are activated immediately after saving; organization and admin-published connections require approval for each version.
revokeConfirm: Disconnect OAuth for {name}? If this is an organization connection, authentication will be revoked for all members.
managedUnknown: Could not confirm sandbox availability. Refresh to check again.
organizationUnavailable: Could not confirm current access to organization connections. This status alone does not tell us whether the connections have been deleted. Refresh to check again.
selectionNone: No local tools selected. No sandbox will be allocated.
selectionLifecycle: Sending automatically prepares an execution sandbox for the selected tools and cleans it up on completion, cancellation, or expiry. Remote MCP credentials are not copied to the sandbox.
selectionReadinessFailed: Could not confirm sandbox tool availability. Refresh to check again. Regular chat remains available if no tools are selected.
selectionStorageFailed: Could not save your tool selection in this browser. It will remain in the current tab but may not be restored when reopened.
selectionChangeFailed: Could not change the tool selection. Refresh the status, then select again.
selectionNativeUnavailable: The execution environment for the selected tools is currently unavailable. Refresh the status or deselect the tools.
selectionNativeInvalid: The selected tool configuration is no longer valid. Review your tool selection and send again.
selectionNativeQuota: The current project or sandbox pool limit has been reached. Retry after executions finish or deselect the tools.
selectionNativeChanged: The approved sandbox configuration has changed. Check the tool status again before starting a new execution.
selectionIssue.permission: Could not verify permission to use tools in this project. Deselect the tools or check your permissions, then send again.
selectionIssue.loading: Checking the status of the selected sandbox tools. Wait for this to finish before sending.
selectionIssue.catalog_failed: Could not confirm the current availability of the selected tools. Refresh or deselect the tools, then send again.
selectionIssue.unavailable: The following tools are currently unavailable: {names}. Deselect them or wait until the execution environment is ready, then send again.
selectionIssue.invalid_saved: Could not read the saved tool selection. Reset the selection, then select again.
selectionIssue.selection_changed: The tool selection changed during verification. Review the current selection and send again.
selectionIssue.owner_changed: The user or project changed during verification. Send again in the current scope.
selectionIssue.too_many: You can select up to 100 local tools.
organizationManagementUnavailable: Could not confirm the current status of organization management permissions. The displayed organization connections remain usable with member permissions.
selectionModelUnsupported: No model is selected, or the current model does not support tool calls. Select a model that supports tools or deselect the local tools.
selectionNativeCodeUnsupported: The selected K3s sandbox tools cannot be used in code execution mode. Use chat or plan mode, or deselect the local tools.
workspace.title: MCP connections
workspace.description: Find tools for chat and manage the services you connect.
workspace.name: Name
schemaHelp: Activation applies only to the displayed configuration version. The latest authentication and tool configuration are revalidated at execution time.
